title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
script:
Amazon just launched TorchNeuron to break Nvidia's grip on PyTorch.
PyTorch is the free toolkit used to build most AI apps.
The new developer tool helps engineers run their applications on alternative chips.
Nvidia hardware currently dominates the market for training large language models.
Amazon wants developers to use its own silicon instead of rival hardware.
Will Amazon's new software toolkit finally weaken Nvidia's market control?
